title: CTRL control / HMI board (two-sided, 4 layers)
note: W2 PCB-CTRL: control / HMI board, two-sided, 4 layers (A-PCB-07). Top: the six TL3145 at the contract switch points, MCP23017 U301-U303, PI4IOE5V9555 U306, the HMI resistors and TVS and the two ENC headers at the cut-outs. Bottom: the THT harness headers (hand-soldered from the top; pin field + 1.0 mm kept free on the top), the Raspberry Pi Pico U305 (its 23.1 x 53.9 mm courtyard does not fit the top between the switch columns and the cut-outs), the buzzer, the LED and the small SMD parts. Iteration 2: scripted LAB5 feed, blower return and fan copper, GND plane vias, fan cluster re-placed. CI/model output of pcb/board_gen.py; not a fabrication release; bench gates OPEN.
